items.text: Giants officially ruled out QB Jaxson Dart for the game due to knee injury after being Q to return.
items.why: Knee injury suffered in game; ruled out mid-contest.
items.implication: Backup QB in for remainder; impacts Giants offense and Nabers.
items.opportunity: Potential for more conservative or different playcalling.

items.text: Malik Nabers questionable to return with shoulder then returned to the field during MNF.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return after evaluation.
items.implication: Maintains WR1 role despite scare; usage continues.
items.opportunity: Full routes if healthy rest of game.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. True GTD earlier resolved to OUT.
items.why: Hip injury, did not practice late week, trending wrong way pregame.
items.implication: Rams WR corps thinner; Adams primary target.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Davante Adams and secondary WRs.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive; grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason.
items.why: McConkey cleared cracked rib (flak jacket possible); Harvey hamstring keeps out.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks; Coleman handcuff/backup role elevated.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; out several weeks, likely IR, rehab over surgery preferred, midseason return possible.
items.why: Heel reinjury; sources confirm multi-week rehab plan.
items.implication: Colts WR depth hit; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other Colts pass-catchers.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL, expected to miss a few weeks. Ertz signed to PS for promotion.
items.why: MCL sprain confirmed via tests post-Sunday game.
items.implication: Multi-week TE absence; Eagles TE depth tested.
items.opportunity: Targets shift to Wicks, Lemon or Ertz if elevated; more to DeVonta Smith.

items.text: Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow, consulting specialists; Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seahawks. Likely miss time.
items.why: Dislocated elbow (repeat); X-rays no fracture, further eval ongoing.
items.implication: Mariota starts Week 3; Daniels timeline TBD post-specialists.
items.opportunity: Commanders skill players see different QB; potential volume shifts.

items.text: Bears coach Ben Johnson: expectation Caleb Williams will likely miss some time with hamstring (same as prior college injury).
items.implication: Bagent likely starts; Bears offense changes.
items.opportunity: Luther Burden, Colston Loveland, others may see adjusted roles under backup.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps, David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29/67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks. Chargers placing both on IR.
items.why: Injuries opened snaps/routes mid-game; IR confirmed.
items.implication: Gadsden TE opportunity surge with both on IR.
items.opportunity: Significant route share and snaps for Gadsden with Herbert.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as lead back; Gainwell clear backup.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, routes for Irving going forward.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + Brown absence creating need for Henderson.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson not locked lead.
items.opportunity: More touches/routes for Henderson in weapon-light offense.

items.text: Weekend statuses: GTD McConkey (optimism)/Nacua; NOT EXPECTED Harvey; EXPECTED Olave/Burrow/Black/McMillan (snap count); OUT Flowers/Pittman. Postgame watchlist includes Daniels, Williams, Barkley, Goedert, Njoku etc.
items.why: Compiled beat/coach reports pre and post Sunday games.
items.implication: Multiple lineup impacts; beneficiaries for OUTs like Flowers/Pittman/Harvey.
items.opportunity: Coleman for Harvey; Bernard for Pittman; others for Flowers.

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess on Rams attack. Pivot Parkinson if flex open; else WR Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford.
items.why: Nacua inactive creates opportunity scramble in Rams passing game.
items.implication: Stream/pivot options for those who started Nacua.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: target shares 27% and 38% first two games, leading all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model lead.
items.implication: Must-start WR with high floor/ceiling on volume.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target share, especially with Goedert out.
